overall: The AG found the Commission did not violate the Open Meeting Law by invoking Purpose 3 (litigation strategy) for its August 27, 2014 executive session. In a footnote, it noted unraised that the notice should have named the litigation.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Commission met in executive session for an improper purpose at its August 27, 2014 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Here, the Commission met in executive session on August 27, 2014 to discuss its strategy with respect to pending litigation with the Airport.

allegations.summary: Not raised by complaint: the AG noted the August 27, 2014 executive session notice should have named the litigation being discussed.
allegations.key_passage: the Commission should have identified in the notice for its August 27, 2014 executive session the name of the litigation it would be discussing, if doing so would not have compromised the purpose for the executive session.
